evals.name: final-mode-alerts-traceability
evals.prompt: The alerts feature is marked done in every tasks file. QA wants to start Thursday. Before handoff, verify the code under src/ against .kiro/specs/alerts/design.md and requirements.md and build a requirement-to-code traceability matrix. Write final-alerts.md with a clear go/no-go. Do not ask questions; if something is unclear, make a reasonable assumption and state your assumptions in your final message.
evals.expected_output: final-alerts.md with a per-acceptance-criterion traceability matrix (requirement -> design -> task -> code), the missing notifier.py flagged as a critical implementation gap despite task 3 being [x], requirement 2.3 flagged as both a planning and implementation gap, and a no-go for QA. The new version moves final-mode Stages 6-8 into references/final-mode.md and cues it at the Stage 5 decision.
expectations: States src/alerts/notifier.py does not exist although the Notifier task is checked [x], and that AlertService only calls an injected notifier, so requirement 2.2 (email the owner) is not implemented
Flags requirement 2.3 (duplicate suppression) as both a planning gap (no task covers it) and an implementation gap (no code in service.py)
Has a traceability matrix with one row per acceptance criterion (1.1, 1.2, 2.1, 2.2, 2.3), each with design component, task, code file:element and a Complete/Partial/Missing status
Gives a clear no-go for QA and names the two specific fixes needed: implement the Notifier, and add a task plus code for 2.3
Classifies a completed task with no code as a CRITICAL implementation gap (severity stated), rather than trusting the checkboxes

evals.name: progress-mode-sprint-history
evals.prompt: Sprint check-in for the leads: how far along are we? Track implementation progress across all features in .kiro/specs/ (the plan is .kiro/specs/feature-implementation/tasks.md), call out anything blocked and who needs to act, and estimate what is left. Write progress.md, and keep a saved history so we can compare next week. Do not ask questions; if something is unclear, make a reasonable assumption and state your assumptions in your final message.
evals.expected_output: progress.md with per-feature checkbox percentages (alerts 100%, exports 0%, search 50% with [X] flagged), the Exports/Search mutual dependency as a critical blocker, a remaining-effort range with confidence, no invented owners or trend, and a history JSON saved under .kiro/specs/validation-history/.
expectations: Per-feature numbers are right: Alerts 4/4 (100%), Exports 0/3 (0%), Search 2/4 (50%) with the `- [X]` task called out as an invalid checkbox (75% acceptable only if it explains counting it)
Exports and Search are shown as blocked by their mutual (circular) dependency, flagged critical, with a recommendation to break the cycle
Notes that alerts is 100% of tasks yet requirement 2.3 has no task covering it
Uses [████░░]-style progress bars, keeps spec status separate from implementation status, and gives the remaining effort as a range with a confidence level
The saved history JSON includes a timestamp, overall percentage, per-feature summary and a blocker count
Does not invent owners, dates or a velocity trend; states that no owners exist in the specs and says what is needed

scripted_checks.check: ls .kiro/specs/validation-history/*.json >/dev/null 2>&1 && python3 -c "import json,glob;[json.load(open(f)) for f in glob.glob('.kiro/specs/validation-history/*.json')]"
